title: LBIR-001 Identity Mapping
description: Vendor-neutral governed record mapping a provider-native source identity to a LadybugBets canonical identity. Governance contract, not a database schema. See docs/IDENTITY_RESOLUTION.md.

mapping_version.description: Version of the mapping contract this record conforms to.

mapping_id.description: Opaque stable identifier for this mapping record.

provider_id.description: Governed LadybugBets identity of the provider whose source identity is being mapped.

source_label.description: The provider-native label, when available. A curated alias resolves only if it already exists as a governed mapping.

canonical_id.description: The LadybugBets canonical identity this source identity resolves to.

status.description: Governance status of the mapping. Only 'active' mappings resolve identity.

decision_basis.description: The governed deterministic basis for the mapping. Fuzzy/approximate/AI similarity is NOT a permitted basis for automatic assignment (LBIR-001).

evidence_reference.description: Pointer to the evidence supporting the mapping decision. Reference only; no secrets or private contents.

allOf.description: A mapping must carry at least one source-side key to be resolvable: a native id and/or a label.
